titulo_es: Talk about people and objects with pronouns

Kvinnan som ringde söker dig.es: La mujer que llamó te busca
Kvinnan som ringde söker dig.en: The woman who called is looking for you.

texto: Unite ideas with relative and avoid repeating the same noun. **Kvinnan som ringde söker dig** means «The woman who called is looking for you.». It relates the expression to the purpose of the text. Look at the connectors and reformulate the idea with your own words before you respond. Sequence 2 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
